rule: A pass is a commit that produced a new board state (a routing or placement change to a hw/*.kicad_pcb file). Passes are numbered sequentially in commit order; pass 1 is the first committed board state. Runs whose boards were never committed are not numbered — they are listed under gaps. Strategy changes live in each entry's description (the changelog), never in the numbering.
